messages:
yuki: noticed a regression during aurora-lite-int8 onboarding: mixed-script guillemet/quote attachment gets split for CJK + RTL snippets. small but reproducible on zh->en and he->en smoke.
arjun: can you paste the failing example and the tokenizer output?
yuki: sure — pasted below.

INPUT: "今日 «שלום» is gone."
TOKENIZER OUT: ["今日", " ", "«", "ש", "ל", "ו", "ם", "»", " ", "is", " ", "gone", "."]
EXPECTED TOKENS: ["今日", " ", "«שלום»", " ", "is", " ", "gone", "."]

eval-bot: run=run-9021, model=aurora-lite-int8, dataset=multilang-kerning, metrics={bleu:-0.62, detach_quotes:0.04}

claire: looks like guillemet attachment logic is splitting when RTL cluster follows; could be a byte-offset vs codepoint boundary issue in the glue layer. arjun: also note we rolled fast-packed quant artifact last Tuesday; small zero-point shifts can change token id collisions and make beam search more sensitive to token fragmentation.
yuki: quick mitigation: preproc rule to join guillemet + contiguous RTL cluster before tokenization. applied locally -> BLEU improved to -0.10 on smoke.
arjun: i'll bisect quant-pack commits to check if packing reorder amplifies the issue and open a revert if needed. also will add a token-id histogram check vs fp16 baseline for sentence-level shifts >1.5%.
claire: i'll open PR for the preproc attach (draft) and add a unit test to locale-suite covering guillemet+RTL+CJK adjacency.
eval-bot: note: adding punctuation-detach detector to nightly pipeline (threshold 0.02).
yuki: assigning tasks: arjun (bisect + detector), claire (preproc PR + tests), i'll collate failing samples and follow up with support.
arjun: ack, will update by EOD.
summary: aurora-lite-int8 onboarding regression: guillemet + RTL clusters adjacent to CJK were split, detaching quotes; short-term fix: preproc attach rule; long-term: bisect quant pack, add token-id histogram checks and locale-suite unit tests
